MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable connects with my history of buying practical display accessories such as a DVI cable, provided its connectors and length fit my setup.",
    "The wired earbuds with a microphone relate to my previous headset purchase, although that connection gives me a reason to consider them rather than an immediate need to buy."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Smart speakers, smart plugs, and TV streaming devices do not solve the computer connection or expansion needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "A tablet mount does not mean I need a new tablet, and memory cards only become useful when I have a compatible device that needs storage.",
    "The Bluetooth speaker serves a different listening purpose from a headset with a microphone, so my headset purchase does not make it a natural next choice."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat owning electronic accessories as a broad interest in home entertainment and smart home devices.",
    "They seem to turn a purchase for a specific device or task into an ongoing need for related devices and replacements."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My WiFi adapter, USB expansion card, and USB Ethernet adapter reflect specific connection needs; the ports, compatibility, and function matter more to me than simply being electronics.",
    "My purchases are infrequent and spread across years, so a past accessory purchase is a weak reason to assume I need another one now.",
    "Even the cable and earbuds would need to fill a current gap in my setup before I would choose them."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my interest in practical accessories but stretch it into demand for electronics that do not address an identified need."
}
